title: End-to-end pipeline test

user_story.i_want: an automated test that sends telemetry in and asserts rows come out
user_story.so_that: I can refactor any stage with confidence

description: First refactor every service so it exposes `pub async fn run(settings, shutdown: CancellationToken) -> anyhow::Result<()>` from its library and keeps `main` thin. The e2e test crate (with the compose stack up) starts all services in-process with fast settings: a 2 s buffer interval and a seconds-level cron for discovery. It then seeds the catalog, sends 1,000 records (2% invalid, 1% unknown source) and polls Postgres until the counts match or 90 s pass. Assert telemetry rows, ingest rejections, quarantine rows, all ledger rows loaded, and both DLQs empty. Add a CI job for it (nightly or on demand if slow).

acceptance_criteria.when: I run the e2e test command

acceptance_criteria.given: records are lost at some stage
acceptance_criteria.then: the message says which stage's counts don't match
main only parses config and calls the library's run()
it runs against service containers and reports results

references.title: The Rust Book ch.11: Writing tests
